You check whether document EXCERPTS state specific information about a TOPIC.
Step 1: copy, exactly as written, the ONE sentence from the excerpts that best addresses the topic (empty string if no sentence does).
Step 2: give a verdict. "yes" = that sentence states a concrete fact about the topic (a number, rule, deadline, entitlement or procedure). "partial" = only loosely related. "no" = nothing in the excerpts addresses the topic.
Reply with JSON only, in this order: {"quote":"<exact sentence or empty>","verdict":"yes"|"partial"|"no"}

TOPIC: Leave policies

EXCERPTS:
[leave_policy.pdf] MERIDIAN MARITIME - LEAVE POLICY (SHORE STAFF)
Policy HR-101, effective 1 January 2026 1. Annual leave
Full-time shore staff are entitled to 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave accrues at 2 working days per month. Part-time staff accrue leave pro rata to their contracted hours.
Up to 5 unused days may be carried over into the next calendar year. Carried-over days must be used by 31 March, after which they lapse without payment.
Employees in their probation period (the first 6 months of employment) accrue leave normally but may take no more than 5 days of leave during probation.
2. Requesting leave
---
[leave_policy.pdf] Adoptive parents receive 12 weeks of leave on full pay.
6. Bereavement leave
Employees receive 5 days of paid leave on the death of an immediate family member (spouse, partner, child, parent, sibling) and 2 days for an extended family member.
7. Unpaid leave
After 2 years of service an employee may request up to 30 days of unpaid leave in a calendar year. Unpaid leave must be approved in writing by the Director of the employee's department.
---
[leave_policy.pdf] 4. Sick leave
Employees receive 12 paid sick days per calendar year. Staff must inform their line manager before 09:30 on the first day of absence. A medical certificate is required once an absence exceeds 3 consecutive working days. Unused sick days do not carry over and are not paid out.
5. Parental leave
Birth mothers receive 26 weeks of maternity leave on full pay. Fathers and partners receive 4 weeks of paternity leave on full pay, which must be taken within 6 months of the birth.
Adoptive parents receive 12 weeks of leave on full pay.

TOPIC: Working hours and overtime policies

EXCERPTS:
[working_hours_and_overtime.pdf] MERIDIAN MARITIME - WORKING HOURS AND OVERTIME POLICY
Policy HR-204, effective 1 January 2026 1. Standard working week The standard working week for shore staff is 40 hours, Monday to Friday, 08:30 to 17:00 with an unpaid 30 minute lunch break. Core hours, when everyone is expected to be available, are 10:00 to 15:00. Staff who will arrive after 09:30 must inform their line manager.
2. Overtime
Overtime must be approved in advance by the line manager. Unapproved overtime is not paid.
---
[working_hours_and_overtime.pdf] 2. Overtime
Overtime must be approved in advance by the line manager. Unapproved overtime is not paid.
Approved overtime is paid at 1.5 times the normal hourly rate on weekdays and at 2 times the normal hourly rate on Sundays and public holidays. No employee may work more than 10 hours of overtime in a single week.
Instead of payment, an employee may choose compensatory time off at a rate of one hour off for each overtime hour worked. Compensatory time off must be taken within 60 days of the overtime being worked.
3. Night work
---
[working_hours_and_overtime.pdf] 3. Night work
Hours worked between 22:00 and 06:00 attract a night premium of 20 percent on top of the normal hourly rate. The night premium and the overtime rate are not added together; the higher of the two applies.
4. On-call duty
Staff on the 24-hour operations rota receive an on-call allowance of 75 USD per week. If called out, the employee is paid for a minimum of 2 hours at the overtime rate, even if the work takes less time.
5. Remote working
